article.title: Acusativo + infinitivo después de verbos de percepción
article.part: Construcciones avanzadas y fenómenos excepcionales — Advanced constructions and exceptional phenomena
article.chapter: Combinaciones avanzadas de cláusulas — Advanced clause combinations

claims.summary: With English perception verbs such as see, hear, and watch, an object-form noun phrase can be the understood subject of a following bare infinitive, as in I saw him cross the street. The bare infinitive commonly views the event as a whole, contrasting with an -ing form that can foreground an event in progress; a related passive typically uses to-infinitive, as in He was seen to leave.

links.notes: Registered Cambridge pedagogical English grammar; supports perception verb complements and bare infinitival complementation.
